{{Top|leg}}
'''Zocolidae''' were a family of microscopic brown [[Worm/Legends|worms]] that were found on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was believed that these worms may have been responsible for crucial ecological processes that helped remove toxic chemicals from the planets' soils, rendering the worlds inhabitable.<ref name="SWG:STGZU">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Save Tatooine's G. Zocolidae Amedus!}}</ref>

A remarkable concentration of Zocolidae was found on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an ongoing study by the [[Vinda'a BioChemical Laboratories]] focused on a minor variant, the [[G. Zocolidae Amedus]] on Tatooine. The study tried to find commercial applications for the worm's biological biochemistry.<ref name="SWG:STGZU" />
